The '''1768 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' will be the 25th edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It is scheduled to be held in [[Sanagara]] and will be the first FLLA World Cup ever staged by a Sanagaran association, as well as the first held in [[Massir]] since the [[1740 FLLA World Cup|1740 edition]] in [[Seytinemas]].

[[File:1768 FLLA World Cup qualification.png|thumb|upright=1.5|{{legend|#000cff|Countries qualified for World Cup}} {{legend|#ffb400|Country did not qualify}} {{legend|black|Countries that did not enter the World Cup or were expelled from the tournament by FLLA prior to playing a match}} {{legend|#ababab|Country not a FLLA member}}]]

[[Sanagara]] was confirmed as host at the FLLA Council meeting of 28 September 1764, six weeks after the conclusion of the [[1764 FLLA World Cup|1764 edition]] in [[Raledria]]. As reigning champions, [[Easuhura]] qualified automatically for the 1768 tournament under the reseeding rules adopted by the FLLA Council in 1761 and re-amended in September 1764. Thirty-two nations are expected to take part, drawn from the seven continental confederations of the [[FLLA]].
